title: Sequoia-incubated Empirik launches with $21M to predict outages before they happen | TechCrunch
summary: As AI accelerates the pace of software development, tools that help infrastructure engineers keep up with constant system changes are more vital than ever, Chandrayana told TechCrunch. “What agentic AI did for software, Empirik wants to do for infrastructure engineering,” he added.
